transcript: Morning run along the canal to start July, warm already even this early, real summer now. Legs feel good, steady base built up over the whole spring. Half the year gone already, strange to think about how different my life looks now compared to New Year's Day.

Finally hung the shelves in the new place tonight, small thing but it's been sitting undone since the move, apartment feels a little more finished with something actually on the walls now. Meridian work steady, good day overall.

First pottery class at the new studio that actually felt fully comfortable, no longer the new person figuring out where things live, starting to know the other regulars a little too. Made a set of small dishes, thinking of them as a matching set for the new kitchen.

Quiet Friday, Dario's coming by tomorrow for a low-key dinner, first time hosting just the two of us since his birthday party. Looking forward to it, no occasion needed anymore, which feels like its own kind of milestone honestly.

Dario and I had our first real argument tonight since everything reopened between us. Started over something small, a comment about Mom, but it wasn't really small at all underneath, it was the actual center of the old fight finally surfacing, the thing we'd been carefully talking around all these months. He thinks Mom enabled the distance between us for too long, let it drag on rather than pushing either of us to fix it. I got defensive fast, felt like he was blaming her for something that was on both of us, and I said so, sharper than I meant to. Voices raised for a minute, real tension in the room, the kind that made me genuinely worried we'd just undone months of careful rebuilding in one bad evening. But neither of us left. We sat with the discomfort instead, kept talking even when it was hard, and eventually got underneath the anger to what was actually there, both of us scared of losing this again now that we'd just gotten it back. We talked it all the way through, past midnight honestly, and landed somewhere neither of us fully agreed on Mom but both of us agreed the relationship mattered more than being right about the past. First real fight and we survived it. I think that might matter more than any of the easy dinners, proof this can hold weight now, not just the good moments.

Holiday morning, quiet run before the day gets going, warm already, going to be a hot one. Neighborhood already smells like someone's grilling somewhere. No plans yet for tonight beyond dinner with Dario.

Texted Dario this morning just to check in after last night, he responded quickly, said he was glad we talked it through instead of letting it fester. Relief settling in. Sometimes the fight itself matters less than what happens right after it.

Mundane Monday, back to Meridian work after the long weekend, steady and fine. Warm evening, sat outside for a while after dinner just enjoying the long summer light, doesn't get properly dark until well past nine now.

Early run before the heat really sets in, learning fast this summer that mornings are the only sane time to be out there once July gets going properly. Canal path shaded enough to still feel bearable even now. Good quiet start to the week.

Planning to have Maya and Tom over for dinner this week, first real meal I'm cooking for guests in the new place beyond Dario's birthday. Thinking through the menu tonight, want it to actually be good, not just edible.

Cooked dinner for Maya and Tom tonight, first proper dinner party in the new apartment, and it actually went well, food turned out good, the new dining space finally getting used the way I pictured when I first walked through it back in June. Used a couple of the pottery dishes I made too, small satisfaction serving food on plates I shaped myself. Good easy evening with two of my oldest friends in a place that's finally starting to feel fully like mine.

Pottery Thursday, working on a bigger piece now, a proper vase, more ambitious than most of what I've attempted so far. Collapsed twice on the wheel before I got the walls thin and even enough to hold their shape. Frustrating but also the kind of frustrating that means you're actually growing at something.

Heat wave properly setting in now, apartment felt like an oven by evening despite the fan running constantly. Barely slept, tossing and turning most of the night, way too warm even with the windows cracked. Going to need to figure out something better for the next few days, this forecast isn't easing up soon apparently.
Extra early run before the heat gets unbearable, already warm at six though, this heat wave is no joke. Cutting the distance short today, better to be smart about it than push through and regret it.

Second night of the heat wave, went and bought a proper fan today since the little desk one clearly isn't cutting it, hoping that helps tonight. Whole city seems sluggish in this heat, even Meridian's office felt subdued today, everyone moving a little slower than usual, air conditioning working overtime.

Went for an evening swim at the community pool near the new place to cool off from the heat wave, first time trying it out, nice little spot, going to make this a regular thing while this heat keeps up.

Sunday market again, browsed this time instead of selling, nice to just wander for once without the nervous energy of last month's booth. Noticed someone at one of the food stalls, a small flicker of interest, the kind you'd have chased a couple years ago without thinking twice. Let it pass this time, not looking for anything right now, content just noticing it without needing to act on it. Heat wave finally breaking a little today too, small relief on multiple fronts.

First cooler morning run in days, huge relief after the heat wave, could actually push the pace a little instead of just surviving the distance. Canal path felt different in the better weather, more people out enjoying it too, dogs and strollers and other runners nodding as we passed.

Cool morning run, first genuinely pleasant one in over a week after the heat wave finally broke overnight. Canal path felt almost peaceful compared to the sluggish heat-wave runs, easy pace, good mood to start the week.

Mundane Monday, Meridian work steady, heat wave officially over according to the forecast, comfortable evening for the first time in almost a week. Slept properly last night for the first time in days, huge difference in how today felt because of it.

Good steady workday at Meridian, contributing more to the bigger picture planning now instead of just executing individual tasks, feels like genuine growth in the role. Canal walk in the evening, comfortable weather again, small ordinary pleasures after last week's heat.

Quiet Wednesday, nothing much to report, work fine, made a simple dinner, read for a while before bed. Some days are just pleasantly uneventful and that's genuinely fine, doesn't need to be more than that.

Regular morning run, nothing special, just the good habit continuing along the canal. Nice to have this be routine now rather than something I have to talk myself into every time the way it was back in November.

Pottery Thursday, finally finished that ambitious vase I've been working on for a week now, walls even, form actually balanced, genuinely proud of this one. Going to let it dry slowly before the first firing. Nice steady rhythm to Thursdays now even in the new studio.

Friday, good tired after a full week at Meridian, nothing dramatic to report just steady solid work. Made a quick cooking experiment with one of Nonna's other recipes Mom sent over recently, didn't turn out quite right but the attempt itself felt good, keeping a little of her alive in the kitchen even imperfectly.
Easy Friday morning run, comfortable weather continuing, legs feeling good after a full week of consistent training. Simple quiet start to the day before a busy one at work.

Six months exactly since I sat in the car on an overcast January Monday and said out loud for the first time that I was burnt out. Reading back over some old entries tonight, hard to fully recognize myself in some of them, the version of me that hadn't yet found pottery, that hadn't heard from Dario in two years, that was still grinding through Atlas without any end in sight, that hadn't lost Nonna yet or found out what that particular grief actually felt like. So much happened in between that January morning and tonight. I actually enjoy my work again, genuinely, most days at Meridian feel like contributing to something instead of just surviving it. I have a brother back, not perfectly, we proved that with the fight two weeks ago, but real, weathered, actually built to last through hard conversations now instead of collapsing at the first one. I run because it steadies something in me, not because an app is telling me to. I make things with my hands now and occasionally someone pays actual money for them, which still feels a little unbelievable every time. I live somewhere with a window that shows me water and light every morning. None of it erases what was hard, Nonna's still gone, Sam and I still didn't work out, the burnout was real and the grief was real. But looking at the whole shape of these six months together, I don't think I'm the same person who wrote that January entry, and mostly, I think I like who I've become instead. Wanted to write that down properly, not just feel it in passing.

Morning run along the canal, quiet reflective mood already starting before I even sat down to write tonight's longer entry. Half marathon fitness still holding up nicely even without formal training right now, just maintaining for the joy of it these days.

Weekend market again, said a friendly hello to the same person from last week at the food stall, nothing more than that, a nice small human moment and then moving on with my day. Content with things exactly as they are right now, no urgency to fill every gap.
Weekend morning run before the market, warm but not brutal, summer settling into a more comfortable rhythm since the heat wave passed. Legs feeling good, easy pace, nice quiet way to start a Sunday.

Lazy Sunday, canal walk, a little reading, called Mom just to talk, no particular reason, first time in a while I've called just to check in rather than around some specific worry. She sounded good, lighter than she has in months, mentioned she's thinking about visiting this fall. Nice normal conversation, the kind that used to feel rare this year and is starting to feel more common again.

Solid Monday at Meridian, nothing remarkable, just steady competent work, which after this year's version of eventful I've come to genuinely appreciate. Evening run, comfortable summer weather holding, good rhythm to the days lately.
Quick morning run, uneventful and good, canal path quiet at this hour, just me and a couple of herons standing in the shallows like always. Nice small ritual to start the day these days.

Pottery Thursday, glazed the big vase from last week finally, curious to see how it turns out once it's fired, took a risk on a color combination I haven't tried before. Good end to the week, small steady joy in a class that's meant so much more to me this year than I expected back when I nervously signed up in January not knowing a single thing about clay.
